messages:
jamie_cs: Rafael (customer) opened a ticket — after rotating their service key, generation endpoints still work but embeddings + rerank are 403. He pasted a curl and says 'worked before rotation'.
eli_eng: can you paste the exact curl + response body? 403 body usually shows missing scope claim.
jamie_cs: pasted:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": { "code": "insufficient_scope", "message": "missing: embeddings, rerank" }}
```
jamie_cs: customer says they only requested a single scope during CLI rotation (they used the quick flag).
eli_eng: hmm. quick-rotate path historically stripped multi-scope CSVs if there were whitespace/quotes. can you grab the token claims from the audit log? @ops-bot any logs for token=sk_live_*** ?
ops-bot: audit: token=sk_live_*** created by user=rafael@acme on 2024-12-01T15:02:04Z, provisioner=cli-rotator-v1, requested_scopes=\"inference, embeddings, rerank\"
ops-bot: token_claims stored: scopes=["inference"]
eli_eng: that explains it — requested_scopes got parsed but claim stored only had inference. likely CSV parse trimmed at comma+space and our parser only splits on ',' without trimming quotes in some codepath.
sana_infra: repro locally: rotate with `--scopes "inference, embeddings, rerank"` yields stored claim scopes=[inference] for tokens issued via cli-rotator-v1. CLI sent a quoted string with leading space which our provisioner ignored.
eli_eng: low effort mitigation: provisioner should trim whitespace and strip quotes. hotfix + backfill required.
megan_support: customer needs immediate unblock — any short-term workaround?
eli_eng: yes: 1) generate a new service token via Console (UI path enforces normalized scopes) OR 2) call admin-rotate with scopes param as JSON array: `--scopes '["inference","embeddings","rerank"]'` which bypasses the CSV parser.
jamie_cs: shared both options to Rafael, he's trying Console first.
megan_support: customer tried Console but they are using SSO-managed org and can't see Console token UI. they asked for an API path we can run on their behalf.
eli_eng: ok, we can create a scoped token for them from our admin plane if they sign an approved auth form. short term I'll create a properly scoped token and send via secure notes.
sana_infra: created a PR to fix parser: trim + accept quoted CSV + unit tests. will push hotfix to staging and then prod patch.
eli_eng: can you also add a guard in token validation that emits a warning if 'inference' present without 'embeddings' or 'rerank' when original request asked for multiple scopes? that might catch malformed stored claims.
sana_infra: added a lightweight check: if requested_scopes in audit != stored_claims then log warning with token id. will roll.
megan_support: Rafael confirmed the temporary admin token unblocked their ingestion pipeline. they will rotate themselves via API once we confirm fix. :thumbsup:
jamie_cs: action items: 1) sana to prod hotfix (timeline: 2h) 2) eli to create admin-signed token & send secure note (done) 3) megan to follow up with customer for verification and close ticket.
ops-bot: deploy-staging: cli-provisioner-parser-fix deployed to staging at 2024-12-01T16:10:12Z
sana_infra: scheduled prod deploy in 45m, will monitor token introspection logs for spikes of mismatched scopes.
eli_eng: thanks team — tagging infra + support for visibility. @megan_support please mark escalated->resolved after customer confirms. :rocket:
